messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets.
Use the medicine exactly as directed.
Ask your doctor or pharmacist if you don't understand how to use an injection.
Prepare an injection only when you are ready to give it.
Do not use it if the medicine looks cloudy, has changed colors, or has particles in it.
Insulin glargine is injected under the skin, using a syringe or insulin pen, once per day at the same time of day.
Insulin can be injected into your upper legs (thighs), upper arms, or stomach area (abdomen).
Do not inject into the same place two times in a row.
Avoid injecting into skin that is damaged, tender, bruised, pitted, thickened, scaly, or has a scar or hard lump.
When treating type 1 diabetes, use your short-acting insulin before meals as directed by your doctor.
Insulin glargine must not be given with an insulin pump or mixed with other insulins.
Do not inject insulin glargine into a vein or a muscle.
Your dose needs may change if you switch to a different brand, strength, or form of this medicine.
Triplet: ["Insulin glargine", "has dose change instruction", "dose needs may change if switch to different brand, strength, or form of medicine"]

The relation 'has dose change instruction' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may require a change in dosage if the patient switches to the specific alternative specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has dose adjustment instruction': The subject drug may require changes in dosage based on the condition or factor specified in the object entity.
B. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
C. 'should be replaced with': The subject drug or treatment should be substituted with the entity specified by the object entity.
D. 'may be prescribed with': The subject drug may be prescribed in combination with the medication specified by the object entity.
E. 'may affect': The subject drug may influence or alter the physiological process or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
